http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/AgentRole.label: Agent Role
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/AgentRole.definition: A role that an agent can take in a specific context.
restrictions: (is performed by some Agent and is performed by only Agent)

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/BWFTeamCompe.label: BWF Team Competition
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/BWFTeamCompe.definition: Team competitions organized by the Badminton World Federation (BWF).

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ChallengeEve.label: Challenge Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ChallengeEve.definition: A challenge event called by a player to challenge a judgement.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ChangeCourtE.label: Change-Court Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ChangeCourtE.definition: A change-court event can happen between sets, or after one player or one pair firstly wins 11 points.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/CompetitionE.label: Competition Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/CompetitionE.definition: A competition event takes place in period of time, composing different draws and matches.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/CourtArea.label: Court Area
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/CourtArea.definition: A court area indicates a particular area in a court.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/DoublePlayer.label: Double Player Role
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/DoublePlayer.definition: A role that a player takes in a double match.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Draw.label: Draw
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Draw.definition: The different match types in badminton (i.e., man single, men double, woman single, women double and mix double).

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/EliminationE.label: Elimination Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/EliminationE.definition: The event for the elimination stage at a tournament.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/EliminationI.label: Elimination Information
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/EliminationI.definition: An information object captures relevant information of the elimination tournament stage.
restrictions: eliminationPlayer some (Pair or Player or Team)
qualified player some (Pair or Player or Team)

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Event.label: Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Event.definition: Activities that take place within a given context or timeframe.
restrictions: (has agent role some Agent Role and has agent role only Agent Role)
(is described by some Information Object and is described by only Information Object)
(occurs at location some Location and occurs at location only Location)
(occurs at time some TemporalEntity and occurs at time only TemporalEntity)

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/EventInforma.label: Event Information
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/EventInforma.definition: An information object captures relevant information of an event.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Geometry.label: Geometry
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Geometry.definition: A coherent set of direct positions in space. The positions are held within a Spatial Reference System (SRS).

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/GetPointEven.label: Get-Point Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/GetPointEven.definition: A get-point event is as the last sub-event in a rally event.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/HittingArea.label: Hitting Area
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/HittingArea.definition: The hitting area in terms of a player when the player hits a shuttle.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/HittingStyle.label: Hittting Style
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/HittingStyle.definition: A hitting style indicates if a shot is hit backhand or forehand.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Location.label: Location
restrictions: (at court area some Court Area and at court area only Court Area)

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/MatchEvent.label: Match Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/MatchEvent.definition: A match event is participated by two single players or two pairs, and contains 3 sets at most.
restrictions: is described by some Match Information
occurs at time exactly 1 Match Time Entity

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/MatchInforma.label: Match Information
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/MatchInforma.definition: An information object captures relevant information of a match.
restrictions: (winByPair exactly 1 Pair or winByPlayer exactly 1 Player)
has match type exactly 1 Match Type

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/MatchType.label: Match Type
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/MatchType.definition: The different match types in badminton (i.e., man single, men double, woman single, women double and mix double).

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/MedicalPause.label: Medical Pause Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/MedicalPause.definition: A medical pause event can be asked by a player.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Pair.label: Pair
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Pair.definition: Pairs in double plays (i.e., men double, women double and mix double).

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/PairPlayersR.label: Pair-Player Role
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/PairPlayersR.definition: A role that a pair of two players takes in a match.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/PenaltyEvent.label: Penalty Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/PenaltyEvent.definition: A penalty event can be called by an umpire.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Person.label: Person
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Person.definition: A person agent can have some roles.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Player.label: Player
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Player.definition: A player in badmintion related events.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/PlayerInform.label: Player Information
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/PlayerInform.definition: An information object captures relevant information of a player.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/PlayerRole.label: Player Role
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/PlayerRole.definition: A role that a player takes in a match.
restrictions: (playedBy some Player and playedBy only Player)

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/RallyEvent.label: Rally Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/RallyEvent.definition: A rally event starts with a serve and ends until one of the two players/pairs wins the point.
restrictions: is described by some Rally Information

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/RallyInforma.label: Rally Information
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/RallyInforma.definition: An information object captures relevant information of a rally.
restrictions: (getPointByPair exactly 1 Pair or getPointByPlayer exactly 1 Player)

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/RestEvent.label: Rest Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/RestEvent.definition: A rest event can happen in between sets and after one of the two players/pairs firstly wins 11 points in a set.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/RoundRobinGr.label: Round Robin Group Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/RoundRobinGr.definition: An event for a round-robin group at a tournament.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/RoundRobinGr.label: Round Robin Information
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/RoundRobinGr.definition: An information object captures relevant information of a round-robin group.
restrictions: qualified player some (Pair or Player or Team)
round robin player some (Pair or Player or Team)

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Serve.label: Serve
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Serve.definition: A serve is always played by a player as a start of a rally.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/SetEvent.label: Set Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/SetEvent.definition: A set event is with in a match and ends after the one player/pair wins 21 points and wins by 2 points at least.
restrictions: is described by some Set Information
occurs at time exactly 1 Set Time Entity

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/SetInformati.label: Set Information
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/SetInformati.definition: An information object captures relevant information of a set.
restrictions: (getSetByPair exactly 1 Pair or getSetByPlayer exactly 1 Player)

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ShotInformat.label: Shot Information
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ShotInformat.definition: An information object captures relevant information of a shot.
restrictions: (has hitting area some Hitting Area and has hitting area only Hitting Area)
(has hitting style some Hittting Style and has hitting style only Hittting Style)
(has route some Shuttle Route and has route only Shuttle Route)
(has shot type some Shot Type and has shot type only Shot Type)
shuttle hit location exactly 1 Shuttle Location
shuttle landing location exactly 1 Shuttle Location

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ShotType.label: Shot Type
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ShotType.definition: A shot can be classfied as a server or a specific stroke.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ShuttleRoute.label: Shuttle Route
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ShuttleRoute.definition: The route of the shuttle after a play hitting a shuttle.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/SinglePlayer.label: Single Player Role
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/SinglePlayer.definition: A role that a player takes in a single match.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Stroke.label: Stroke
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Stroke.definition: A stroke is played a player after serving in a rally.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/StrokeEvent.label: Stroke Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/StrokeEvent.definition: A stroke event is about a player hitting a shuttle.
restrictions: is described by some Player Information
is described by exactly 1 Shot Information

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/SudirmanCupC.label: Sudirman Cup Competition
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/SudirmanCupC.definition: Mixed team competition organized by BWF.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/SummerOlymip.label: Summer Olympics Competition
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/SummerOlymip.definition: A badminton competition in a summer olympics.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Team.label: Team
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/Team.definition: A team in a team-baed competition.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ThomasCupCom.label: Thomas Cup Competition
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/ThomasCupCom.definition: Men team competition organized by BWF.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/UberCupCompe.label: Uber Cup Competition
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/UberCupCompe.definition: Women team competition organized by BWF.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/WithdrawalEv.label: Withdrawal Event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/WithdrawalEv.definition: A withdrawal event can be called by a player/pair during/before a match.

http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Agent.label: Agent
http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Agent.definition: An agent (eg. person, group, software or physical artifact).

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/atCourtArea.label: at court area
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/atCourtArea.definition: atCourtArea is to represent the location of a player/shuttle at a specific court area.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/eliminationS.label: eliminationStage
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/eliminationS.definition: eliminationStage represents in which stage that an elimination play is.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasAgentRole.label: has agent role
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasAgentRole.definition: hasAgentRole represents that an event can have some agents playing specific roles.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasDraw.label: has draw
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasDraw.definition: hasDraw represents that a particular competition can have different draws (e.g., man single, men doubble, woman single, women double and mix double).

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasHittingAr.label: has hitting area
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasHittingAr.definition: hasHittingArea represents that a shot is hit at a particular area in terms of the player.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasHittingSt.label: has hitting style
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasHittingSt.definition: hasHittingStyle represents that if a shuttle is hit backhand or forehand by a player.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasMatchType.label: has match type
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasMatchType.definition: hasMatchType represents that the match type is captured by a match-information object.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasPlayer.label: has player
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasPlayer.definition: hasPlayer represents that some entities can associate with players/pairs/teams.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasRoleA.label: hasRoleA
domain: (Match Information or Set Information or Shot Information)

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasRoleB.label: hasRoleB
domain: (Match Information or Set Information or Shot Information)

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasRoute.label: has route
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasRoute.definition: hasRoute represents that the route of a shuttle after hitting.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasShotType.label: has shot type
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasShotType.definition: hasShotType represents that the shot type is captured by a shot-information object.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasSubEvent.label: has sub-event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasSubEvent.definition: hasSubEvent represents that an event can have another event as a sub-event.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasSuperEven.label: has super-event
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hasSuperEven.definition: hasSuperEvent represents that an event can have another event as a super-event.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hittingPlaye.label: hitting player
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/hittingPlaye.definition: hittingPlayer represents that the player who hits a shot is captured by a shot-information object.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/isDescribedB.label: is described by
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/isDescribedB.definition: isDescribedBy represents that an event can be described an information object that captures relevant information.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/isPerformedB.label: is performed by
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/isPerformedB.definition: isPerformedBy represents that an agent role is performed by an agent.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/occursAtLoca.label: occurs at location
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/occursAtLoca.definition: occursAtLocation represents that an event takes place at a location.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/occursAtTime.label: occurs at time
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/occursAtTime.definition: occursAtTime represents that an event takes place at a time.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/playerLocati.label: player location
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/playerLocati.definition: playerLocation represents that a player's location is captured by a player-information object.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/qualifiedPla.label: qualified player
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/qualifiedPla.definition: The players/pairs/teams are qualified in a round-robin group or elimination stage.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/receivingPla.label: receiving player
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/receivingPla.definition: receivingPlayer represents that the player who will receive a shot is captured by a shot-information object.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/relatesToCom.label: relates to competition
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/relatesToCom.definition: relatesToCompetition represents the type of competition for a competition event.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/roundRobinGr.label: roundRobinGroupStage
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/roundRobinGr.definition: roundRobinGroupStage represents in which stage that a round-robin play is.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/roundRobinPl.label: round robin player
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/roundRobinPl.definition: roundRobinPlayer represents that a group in a round robin tournament can have some players/pairs/teams.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/shuttleHitLo.label: shuttle hit location
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/shuttleHitLo.definition: shuttleHitLocation represents that a shuttle's hit location is captured by a shot-information object.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/shuttleLandi.label: shuttle landing location
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/shuttleLandi.definition: shuttleLandingLocation represents that a shuttle's landing location is captured by a shot-information object.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/currentWorld.label: current working ranking
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/currentWorld.definition: The current world ranking of a player/pair.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/highestWorld.label: highest world ranking
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/highestWorld.definition: The highest world ranking of a player/pair.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/matchScoreA.label: match score A
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/matchScoreA.definition: The match score of player/pair A.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/matchScoreB.label: match score B
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/matchScoreB.definition: The match score of player/pair B.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/personFullNa.label: person full name
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/personFullNa.definition: The full name of a person.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/rallyLoseRea.label: rally lose reason
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/rallyLoseRea.definition: The lose reason of a rally.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/rallyWinReas.label: rally win reason
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/rallyWinReas.definition: The win reason of a rally.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/roundScoreA.label: round score A
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/roundScoreA.definition: The set score of player/pair A.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/roundScoreB.label: round score B
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/roundScoreB.definition: The round score of player/pair B.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/setScoreA.label: set score A
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/setScoreA.definition: The set score of player/pair A.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/setScoreB.label: set score B
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/setScoreB.definition: The set score of player/pair B.

http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/shotNumber.label: shot number
http://w3id.org/BadmintONTO/shotNumber.definition: The number of shots in a rally.

http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#asW.label: asWKT
http://www.opengis.net/ont/geosparql#asW.definition: The WKT serialization of a Geometry.
